description: Sympathetic neuron (SN_simple) built from its parts: a soma (soma, version sympathetic), an axon cable (axon, version sympathetic_monolithic_v01) and a varicosity (varicosity, version sympathetic), coupled soma -> axon -> varicosity. The soma's membrane gives the axon V and takes its axial current; the axon sets the varicosity membrane's potential. The soma and varicosity are themselves built from their parts, with the ion channels as submodules (cell/ion_channels, versions Argus2026_v01; RyR HernandezCruz1997_v01 since review 2026-10-06). A model uses one record, e.g. {"name": "SN", "module_type": "neuron", "module_subtype": "sympathetic", "instance": "default"}; the expanded parts are named SN_soma_<part>, SN_axon and SN_varicosity_<part>.
